ideal.name: stock_all
ideal.scope: All one-year usable water initially on Moon; at most declared isolatedC loss events. Initial-water transport route is chosen independently by integrated model.
ideal.hardware_service_life_assumption: Storage tanks are delivered and commissioned during late prepositioning, with at least the modeled one-year rated service after commissioning. No centuries-long storage durability is assumed.
ideal.guarantee_boundary: Quantity only; long-duration water quality, thermal control and isolation require engineering evidence.

ideal.name: recycle_0.94_R_2flights_daily

receiver.scope: Empty initial FIFO queue; complete port outages allowed within rolling budget; work-conserving open-day receiving. Conservative queue plus service bound, not exact worst delay.

certificate.scope: Sufficient daily-quantity guarantee, independent capture/processor calendars; arbitrary correlations within declared rolling supports. Not exact minimum reserve or a shortage probability.
certificate.conservatism: Minimum of two independently proved safe loss/backlog envelopes; separate calendar budgets remain explicit. Sufficient reserve, not a minimum-reserve theorem.

processor.scope: Capacity modules are design units; mass, power, cost and water quality require separately stated engineering inputs. K is after the declared number of modules is unavailable.

components.tank_fault_model: Single union of raw/fresh isolated-compartment incidents; raw loss is eta*raw_t in the recovered-water-equivalent ledger, at mostC. Each reservoir class has its own capacity spare. Repair<=Pdays.
components.source_scope: Conditional designed service calendar and mission interface; not observations or empirical availability.
components.R_vehicle_scope: R vehicles are expended; their manufacture, propellant and operations belong in each launch cost parameter. No reusable R hull pool is assumed.
components.cargo_hull_support_scope: The cargo-loss budget includes every loss before successful delivery, including cargo destroyed with a hull. The permanent-hull budget may also include losses on the empty return. These are not added as two disjoint pre-delivery cargo-loss budgets.
components.E_staging_scope: All one-year new cargo and retained propellant staged at one fixed-capacity harbour before habitation; reusable dry hulls charged separately with explicit reuse credit by integrated model.

ideal.scope: Finite catalogue, sufficient quantity/service certificates. Multi-zone candidates use distinct source reservations, independent inventories and one redundant processor per fault-mode zone; they do not rely on an unproved pooled inventory policy.
ideal.guarantee_boundary: Domestic/medical service-water scope; agricultural/industrial/cooling water flows require added inputs. Isolation, purification quality, storage aging and module performance are engineering assumptions.

At least one year of rated service after commissioning is assumed, not empirically calibrated.
